2609.22790.title: From Research Frontier to Laboratory Bench: Design of a Four-Tier Experimental Teaching System for Multimodal Medical Image Intelligent Diagnosis
2609.22790.paper_summary: Undergraduate programmes in intelligent medical engineering are expanding, yet laboratory curricula lag behind the multimodal, long-tailed, and distributionally shifting realities of clinical AI. This design paper presents an advanced experimental teaching system that translates an ongoing multimodal deep learning research project on endometrial carcinoma into a structured undergraduate lab sequence. We identify three educational gaps (modality, authenticity, and deployment) and derive four pedagogical principles from constructive alignment, experiential learning, the research teaching nexus, and the CDIO framework. The curriculum comprises four progressive tiers plus an engineering layer, with 32 laboratory units over 64 contact hours, delivered via a custom virtual clinical workstation using de-identified multi-institutional data. Each tier maps to a specific technical bottleneck, prerequisite coursework, and criterion-referenced deliverables. Data governance, safety, and assessment protocols are specified. Learning outcome data will be collected across two implementation cycles.
2609.22790.paper_summary_zh: 本科智能醫療工程課程正在擴展，但實驗室課程卻落後於臨床AI的多模態、長尾和分佈性變化的現實。這篇設計論文提出了一個先進的實驗教學系統，將一個關於子宮內膜癌的持續多模態深度學習研究項目轉化為一個結構化的本科實驗室序列。我們確定了三個教育差距（模態、真實性和部署），並從建設性對齊、體驗式學習、研究教學聯繫和CDIO框架中推導出四個教學原則。課程包括四個漸進層次加上一個工程層，擁有32個實驗單元，總共64小時的接觸時間，通過使用去識別的多機構數據的自定義虛擬臨床工作站進行授課。每個層次對應於一個特定的技術瓶頸、先修課程和基準參考成果。數據治理、安全性和評估協議已被明確規定。學習成果數據將在兩個實施週期中收集。
